_about: MiniMax post prompts for silent expression videos (docs/WRITERS_ROOM.md §6, docs/VOICES.md §5): appended after your own prompt (the face, the framing), each one a 4 s performance in the user's format: present tense, what the face visibly does in two or three moves, the last one held (so the expression tool can stretch it to `secs` and loop the held part, `loop`, as fractions of the clip). Written for she/her; the writers' room swaps in he/his for a he. No speech, no camera moves. `tags` say what it's for: listen (a face while she waits for your answer), tell (a reaction that gives her away: the L.A. Noire moments), warm, unsettling, sad, fear. Captured, an expression keeps the prompt's id as its name.

prompts.name: Listening, warm
prompts.prompt: she tilts her head slightly and her eyes soften, a small patient smile settling as she keeps her gaze on the viewer.
prompts.use: she waits for your answer and wants to hear it

prompts.name: Listening, guarded
prompts.prompt: her polite smile stays in place as her eyes narrow a fraction, she glances at the viewer's mouth and back up to the eyes, waiting.
prompts.use: she waits for your answer and is afraid of what it will be

prompts.name: Waiting, hopeful
prompts.prompt: her brows lift a little as she leans in, lips parted, her eyes searching the viewer's face for an answer.
prompts.use: a question she needs you to answer the right way

prompts.name: Waiting, blank
prompts.prompt: her face goes still and unreadable, she blinks once, slowly, and keeps looking at the viewer without any expression.
prompts.use: she waits and gives nothing away

prompts.name: Nervous lip bite
prompts.prompt: her eyes roll up as she bites her lower lip, she nervously looks down and then back at the viewer.
prompts.use: you got close to something she doesn't want to say

prompts.name: The lie: a glance away
prompts.prompt: she smiles at the viewer, then her eyes slide away to the side for a moment and snap back, the smile a little too wide.
prompts.use: she answers, and what she said isn't true

prompts.name: Fear, smoothed over
prompts.prompt: her eyes widen for a split second and her lips tighten, then she forces her face back into a calm smile at the viewer.
prompts.use: a name or a place frightens her and she hides it

prompts.name: Guilt
prompts.prompt: her smile falters, her gaze drops to the floor and she swallows, then she slowly looks back up at the viewer.
prompts.use: she did something, and you just touched it

prompts.name: Relief, too much
prompts.prompt: her shoulders drop as she lets out a breath, her eyes turn glassy and she smiles at the viewer a little too gratefully.
prompts.use: you said what she needed to hear, and it mattered more than it should

prompts.name: Contempt, a flash
prompts.prompt: one corner of her mouth twitches into a brief sneer that she quickly smooths away, her eyes cold on the viewer.
prompts.use: what she really thinks of someone, for half a second

prompts.name: Recognition
prompts.prompt: she freezes, her eyes fix on something just past the viewer and her lips part, then she pulls her gaze back with a tight smile.
prompts.use: she recognises something you said, or something behind you

prompts.name: Anger, held in
prompts.prompt: her jaw tightens and her nostrils flare slightly, she holds a stiff smile while her eyes stay hard on the viewer.
prompts.use: you said the wrong thing and she won't show how angry it made her

prompts.name: Laughing it off
prompts.prompt: she laughs silently through her nose, looks down and shakes her head a little, then glances back at the viewer with a crooked smile.
prompts.use: a question she'd rather not answer, waved away

prompts.name: Sadness, rehearsed
prompts.prompt: her brows pinch up into a sad look that arrives a beat too late, her eyes dry and watchful on the viewer.
prompts.use: grief she's performing: the tell is the timing

prompts.name: Pleased, privately
prompts.prompt: a slow private smile spreads across her face as she looks down, then she peeks back up at the viewer through her lashes.
prompts.use: something went the way she wanted

prompts.name: Shock, masked
prompts.prompt: her face drains of expression, her eyes go wide and unblinking, then she blinks hard and looks back at the viewer as if nothing happened.
prompts.use: you know something she thought you didn't

prompts.name: A look at the door
prompts.prompt: her eyes flick toward the side of the room and back, she wets her lips and keeps a thin smile for the viewer.
prompts.use: she's checking whether someone is listening, or how to leave

prompts.name: A memory
prompts.prompt: her gaze drifts to the side as she remembers something, a small sad smile tugs at her mouth, then she looks back at the viewer.
prompts.use: an old memory you share, a good one

prompts.name: Too still
prompts.prompt: she stops blinking, her smile stays fixed as her head tilts very slowly to one side, her eyes locked on the viewer.
prompts.use: the moment the player should feel something is wrong with her

prompts.name: Tears, held back
prompts.prompt: her chin trembles and her eyes fill, she presses her lips together hard and looks up to stop the tears, then back at the viewer.
prompts.use: the truth hurts and she won't cry in front of you

prompts.name: Glad to see you
prompts.prompt: her face lights up, her eyes crinkling into a wide, genuine smile as she looks straight at the viewer.
prompts.use: the welcome at the door

prompts.name: Shy smile
prompts.prompt: she smiles and looks down shyly, tucks her chin, then glances back up at the viewer with warm eyes.
prompts.use: a compliment, a closeness she likes

prompts.name: Teasing
prompts.prompt: she narrows her eyes playfully and smirks, raising one eyebrow at the viewer.
prompts.use: she doesn't believe you, fondly

prompts.name: Tired and fond
prompts.prompt: she gives a tired, fond smile, her eyelids heavy, and blinks slowly at the viewer.
prompts.use: late at night, at ease with you

prompts.name: An awkward pause
prompts.prompt: her smile stiffens, she glances away and then back, her eyebrows raised as if waiting for the viewer to fill the silence.
prompts.use: years since you last talked: the small talk runs out

prompts.name: Concerned
prompts.prompt: her brows draw together and she leans in slightly, studying the viewer's face with worried eyes.
prompts.use: she worries about you (or wants you to think she does)

prompts.name: Embarrassed
prompts.prompt: she winces with a small laugh, scrunching her nose, then covers it with a sheepish smile at the viewer.
prompts.use: something mundane gone wrong: the mess, the burnt tea

prompts.name: Flustered
prompts.prompt: her cheeks flush as she looks away with a flustered smile, then sneaks a look back at the viewer.
prompts.use: you said something kind she didn't expect

prompts.name: The smile that stays
prompts.prompt: her smile widens slowly and stays, but her eyes do not change, unblinking on the viewer.
prompts.use: the first time her face doesn't match her words

prompts.name: Head tilt
prompts.prompt: she tilts her head too far to one side and stares at the viewer, her expression perfectly calm.
prompts.use: late: what she is shows through

prompts.name: Gone cold
prompts.prompt: the warmth leaves her face all at once, her mouth flattens and her eyes go dull as she looks at the viewer.
prompts.use: the answer she didn't want: the turn

prompts.name: Delight, wrong
prompts.prompt: her eyes go bright and wide with delight, she presses her lips together to hold in a giggle, staring at the viewer.
prompts.use: she's happy about something terrible

prompts.name: Listening to something else
prompts.prompt: she stops, her eyes drift up and to the side as if listening to something inside the walls, then slowly return to the viewer.
prompts.use: she hears what you can't

prompts.name: Grief breaking through
prompts.prompt: her face crumples for a moment, her brows pulling together, then she steadies her breath and looks back at the viewer with red eyes.
prompts.use: the loss under everything

prompts.name: Pleading
prompts.prompt: her brows tilt up and her eyes glisten as she leans toward the viewer, lips parted, silently begging.
prompts.use: she needs you to stay, or to believe her

prompts.name: Resigned
prompts.prompt: she closes her eyes for a long moment, lets out a slow breath, then opens them and gives the viewer a small resigned nod.
prompts.use: she accepts what's going to happen

prompts.name: Realisation
prompts.prompt: her eyes widen slowly as something dawns on her, her lips part, and she stares at the viewer in quiet horror.
prompts.use: she understands what you are, or what you did

prompts.name: Suspicious
prompts.prompt: her eyes narrow and she studies the viewer's face from side to side, her lips pressed into a thin line.
prompts.use: she doesn't believe you

prompts.name: Somewhere else
prompts.prompt: her eyes lose focus and stare through the viewer, her face slack, then she blinks and comes back into the room.
prompts.use: the moment she isn't really there

prompts.name: Cheer, put on
prompts.prompt: she snaps into a bright cheerful smile, too fast, her eyes flat behind it as she looks at the viewer.
prompts.use: everything's fine, she says

prompts.name: The truth, calmly
prompts.prompt: she holds the viewer's gaze steadily, her face serious and calm, and gives a single slow nod.
prompts.use: she isn't lying now: the face to compare the others with

prompts.name: Scared still
prompts.prompt: her breath quickens, her eyes dart to the viewer and freeze, she holds completely still with her lips trembling.
prompts.use: something is in the room with you both
